usageQuery.dateInterpretation: CLI date arguments use America/Los_Angeles day boundaries. The query includes the current day's window; figures reflect data returned at observation time.

billing.limitation: The arithmetic estimate is 20 minus (total effective cost minus the Pro subscription line). Effective cost includes resources with their own included allocations and is not a live credit ledger. Billed cost is near zero at floating-point precision; it is not a guarantee of future zero charges. No exact credit balance or general spend hard cap was exposed by the bounded read-only CLI/API paths.

dashboardEvidence.source: Existing authenticated IAB dashboard, inspected read-only by the parent task after the CLI preflight
dashboardEvidence.limitation: Rounded dashboard bytes are bounded conservatively. The production dedicated workspace mapping still requires verification; the existing preview Redis URL must match the observed endpoint hostname. This snapshot does not assert a permanent zero-cost wall.

protectedProductionEnvPull.limitation: The pull did not yield a candidate that passed strict HTTPS Upstash endpoint validation. Dispatch stopped before any Redis request; sensitive environment values cannot be read later according to the installed CLI guidance. No secret or raw environment value was printed or retained in this report.

historicalReference.limitation: Historical rounded counters remain immutable and cannot establish current quota remaining or current project-to-database mapping.

redis.infoCounterLimitation: Even a successful Redis INFO read would establish memory/lifetime counters only. Monthly command and bandwidth remaining require current management-plane billing/quota evidence.
